title: True Blue Account: Same-Day ACH and Mobile Deposits
summary: Covers True Blue Account same-day ACH (included at no additional fee, if time-sensitive designate the correct same-day option during initiation) and mobile check deposits (daily limit $50,000; split or wait to next business day if exceeding). Also explains out-of-network ATM fee rebates (max $30 per month; keep receipts and ensure rebates don’t exceed $30 monthly cycle) and provides related best practices.
